notes: Policy number, named insured, and policy period repeat in policy-level header blocks. The claim table header repeats on continuation pages. A single claim number can appear on multiple rows for different Type of Payment values, with a two-line Description row following each detail row. The claim status appears as (Closed) within the Claim # cell, while the source header combines Closed and Subro as "Closed Subro". Several policy periods have no claims.
